theorems.name: BP_E2_CRYPTO_PUBLIC_TRACE
theorems.statement:
forall file_bytes initial_rw1 padding1 initial_rw2 padding2 stackpointer ra p q n m1 m2 rp xp ordinary s1 a1 s2 a2 trace1 trace2 t1 t2.
    bp_e2_crypto_public_pre file_bytes initial_rw1 padding1 stackpointer ra p
    q
    n
    m1
    rp
    xp
    ordinary
    (s1,a1) /\
    bp_e2_crypto_public_pre file_bytes initial_rw2 padding2 stackpointer ra p
    q
    n
    m2
    rp
    xp
    ordinary
    (s2,a2) /\
    crypto_first_ret_execution trace1 s1 t1 /\
    crypto_first_ret_execution trace2 s2 t2
    ==> trace1 = crypto_public_call 270800960 p q n stackpointer ra /\
        trace2 = crypto_public_call 270800960 p q n stackpointer ra /\
        trace1 = trace2 /\
        read RIP t1 = ra /\
        read RSP t1 = word_add stackpointer (word 8) /\
        read RIP t2 = ra /\
        read RSP t2 = word_add stackpointer (word 8)
